name: multitask_vqa_benchmark
description: A collection of visual question answering tasks aggregated into a single benchmark to evaluate models' ability to answer questions about images across diverse VQA formats. It tests both open-ended answer generation and selection from choices, covering commonsense, object, and scene understanding queries. The benchmark emphasizes generalization across varied VQA distributions.
reputation: A smaller, aggregated VQA benchmark hosted on Hugging Face; used for research but not a leading community standard.
